title: Stateful association setup with COTP CR and MMS Initiate
purpose: Provide a conservative valid association-oriented seed that enters transport/session handling before minimal MMS initiate parsing.

messages.label: Minimal MMS Initiate request in ACSE/UserInformation wrapper

expected_behavior: Server accepts transport/session establishment attempt and parses a minimal initiate request path without requiring malformed data handling.
constraints_preserved: TPKT version byte is 0x03 on every message
TPKT total-length fields match complete message sizes
Layering follows supplied IEC 61850 overview with COTP then ACSE/UserInformation then MMS
MMS Initiate uses documented PDU type tag 0xA8
Conservative model-prior completion used only for minimal BER field arrangement because full ASN.1 layout was not supplied
issue_safety_notes: Safe valid analogue only; no malformed lengths, recursion tricks, or historical exploit payloads included.
